changes.intent: BUG FIX (2026-08-04): _clearImage() called setState() during dispose(), failing Flutter assertion '_lifecycleState != _ElementLifecycle.defunct' (14 widget tests failed). Root cause: setState() is forbidden in dispose(); 'if (mounted)' still passes during dispose.
changes.donor_evidence: flutter test failure: package:flutter/src/widgets/framework.dart Failed assertion '_lifecycleState != _ElementLifecycle.defunct' at _NiceImageViewState.dispose
changes.target_adaptation: Added notify param to _clearImage({bool notify = true}); setState guarded by 'notify && mounted'; dispose() calls _clearImage(notify: false) so listeners are removed without any setState.
changes.rollback: Revert _clearImage to always setState; restore dispose() to call _clearImage()

changes.intent: BUG FIX (2026-08-04): _resolveImage() called createLocalImageConfiguration(context) from initState(), which depends on inherited widget MediaQuery — illegal before initState completes ('dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<MediaQuery>() was called before initState() completed').
changes.donor_evidence: flutter test failure: dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<MediaQuery>() called before _NiceImageViewState.initState() completed; stack _resolveImage -> createLocalImageConfiguration -> MediaQuery.maybeDevicePixelRatioOf
changes.target_adaptation: Removed the _resolveImage() call from initState(); image resolution now runs in didChangeDependencies() (called immediately after initState, where inherited lookups are legal). didUpdateWidget still re-resolves on image change.

changes.intent: DFX false-positive fix (2026-08-04): dfx rule-6 regex Image\s*\(\s*['"] matched the doc-comment example 'AssetImage('assets/avatar.jpg')' even though the library never uses the Image widget (renders via CustomPainter canvas.drawImageRect).
changes.donor_evidence: dfx-quality fix_dart.py exit 2 with 1 warning on lib/; human review confirmed false positive on the API doc example
changes.target_adaptation: Changed the doc-comment example to use a provider variable (image: myAvatarProvider) instead of inline AssetImage('assets/avatar.jpg'); no API change.

rejected_donor_changes.reason: Flutter canvas.clipPath() achieves equivalent clipping without either API. This is an improvement, not a gap.
Flutter operates in logical pixels natively; no density conversion needed. Removed entirely.
Flutter uses Dart constructor parameters with defaults, not XML attributes. Replaced with const constructor params.
